name: Railway/Senior Citizen Facilities
target_group: Eligible senior citizens using Indian Railways services
eligibility: Facilities depend on current Indian Railways rules and may change; check official railway information before travel.
benefits: Senior-citizen-related passenger facilities/concessions as available under current railway rules.
application_process: Use the Indian Railways/IRCTC booking and passenger-service process and follow current rules.
source: Ministry of Railways / Government of India
